title: L2P prompt pool with shared-basis Mirror prompt generation
hypothesis: For task prompts lying on a Givens orbit, one physical prompt basis plus one code per slot will preserve retrieval-conditioned continual classification quality with fewer payload bytes than an explicit L2P prompt pool, and outperform a same-sized scalar prompt basis; unrelated prompt families should require private vectors.
physical_object: one frozen linear classifier and one shared prompt vector
mirror_coordinate: one Givens angle per prompt slot; nearest-key retrieval selects a rotated view
logical_multiplicity: eight task-specific prompts selected from input queries without task identity

model.retrieval: same Euclidean nearest-key rule for all methods; keys are per-task train-input centroids and charged in every inference payload; task ID is not passed to the model

controls: explicit L2P pool: one learned 32D prompt per task plus shared retrieval keys and frozen classifier
shared prompt basis plus one direct scalar gain per slot
shared prompt basis plus one Givens angle per slot
prompt hypernetwork conditioned on the retrieved slot ID, with generator and slot embeddings fully charged
development_gate_before_fresh: For aligned prompts in both development seeds: retrieval accuracy >=0.95; Mirror macro test accuracy within 0.02 of explicit pool; Mirror exceeds scalar basis by >=0.05 macro accuracy; actual payload <=0.80x explicit pool; and no task accuracy is more than 0.05 below explicit. Unrelated family is boundary evidence, not a pass gate. If any aligned gate fails, fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh aligned worlds replicate retrieval and quality gates; Mirror <=0.80x explicit prompt bytes and beats scalar quality; report unrelated prompt degradation, retrieval errors, prompt generation MACs, throughput, and exact replay.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any registered aligned quality, retrieval, or byte gate in both development seeds, or simple scalar/hypernetwork controls match within 5 percentage points.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: all slot angles/scalars/embeddings and hypernetwork weights
slot IDs, metadata, and archive headers

boundaries: synthetic continual classification only; no L2P benchmark claim
all methods use the same retrieval keys/rule; task identity remains hidden at inference
eight prompt slots are not eight independent capacities; per-task test quality and retrieval are authoritative
fixed-update evidence is not a capacity claim
fresh IDs remain sealed until the full aligned development gate passes
